a.lede: Jensen Huang could be back in his old Nvidia office soon as allies rally to push the AI chipmaker to take him back just days after he was ousted over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
a.title: Jensen Huang could be plotting return as Nvidia CEO, report claims

b.lede: The Taipei 101 skyscraper was lit up with messages of support for Jensen Huang overnight, the former Nvidia CEO who left the company after admitting to an affair with a former customer who has been accused of being a Chinese Spy. Another affair, this time with an employee, has since been reported.
b.title: Taipei 101 lit up in support of Jensen Huang
